about: Lab status of every CCNA 3 lab of cad4ac9 (ARCHITECTURE-P3C D3, §9.5, §10.1 accept.p3c.lab-status-p3), recorded from the unchanged engine at commit cad4ac9 before any P3c code: the evaluateLab status, with every detail string, unsolved at 60 s and solved at 710 s (the reference solution applied at 60 s, no learner action). The labs are the keys of this file, frozen by lab id. Change it only as P3C §9.5 allows, entry by entry, by re-recording with NF_RECORD_LAB_STATUS_P3.
